# Initialize Tasktra

Use when adopting Tasktra in an empty or existing repository. Adoption is preview-first: inspect before writing, present the proposed profile and every file impact, preserve existing instructions, then run configuration and drift checks.

## Procedure

1. Run `tasktra init --root <root> --preview --verbose`. Treat the result as read-only bounded inventory evidence, not authorization to write or proof that existing instructions are semantically equivalent.
2. Review every managed write, preserved project-owned path, conflict, capability gap, uncertainty, and validation command. Existing `AGENTS.md`, `.agents`, `.codex`, and `.claude` content remains project-owned; never overwrite it to make adoption appear clean.
3. Resolve conflicts and select the project-owned profile explicitly. Do not infer pack activation, credentials, authority, or semantic equivalence from the inventory.
4. Apply only after the preview and file impact have been reviewed: `tasktra init --root <root> --apply`. Preserve the preview result with the adoption decision.
5. Run `tasktra compile --root <root> --check` to expose projection and metadata drift, then run the configured validation plan. Execute validation only when it is within the current authority and scope.

Return the previewed writes and preserved paths, conflicts or uncertainty, the explicit adoption decision, and compile/validation results.
